[[Sarah Natochenny]] ([[SM085]]-[[SM112]]) }} '''Lusamine's Clefable''' (Japanese: '''ルザミーネのピクシー''' ''Lusamine's Pixy'') is [[Lusamine]]'s main {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that she owns in the {{pkmn|games}}, {{aniseries|PTS}}, and the {{pkmn|manga}}. ==In animation== [[File:Lusamine Clefable Magic Guard.png|thumb|left|250px|{{a|Magic Guard}} activated]] Clefable has been owned by {{an|Lusamine}} since she was still a {{p|Cleffa}}. She used to play a lot with {{an|Lillie}} and {{an|Gladion}} when the two were young. At some point, she [[Evolution|evolved]] into a {{p|Clefairy}}, and later into a Clefable with a [[Moon Stone]] against Lillie's wishes, as shown in a fantasy in ''[[SM044|A Dream Encounter!]]''. Clefable debuted as a Cleffa in ''[[SM008|Lillie's Egg-xhilarating Challenge!]]'' in a [[Photography|photograph]] at Lillie's house, in which she was being held by Lillie. The photo later reappeared in ''[[SM027|A Glaring Rivalry!]]''. In a flashback in ''[[SM049|Mission: Total Recall!]]'', she was seen playing with Lillie as a Clefairy. Clefable physically debuted in ''[[SM050|Faba's Revenge!]]'', when Lusamine sent her out to battle {{DL|Ultra Beasts (anime)|Nihilego}}, only to be recalled when her energy had been drained. When Lusamine was later subjected to Nihilego's control, Clefable was sent out to stop {{Ash}} and Lillie in ''[[SM053|Rescuing the Unwilling!]]''. She briefly battled [[Snowy]] and [[Ash's Lycanroc]] before Lillie was able to break Clefable free of Nihilego's control by reminding her of their past together. In ''[[SM055|The Professors' New Adventure!]]'', Clefable attended the wedding of {{an|Professor Kukui|Professors Kukui}} and {{an|Professor Burnet|Burnet}} alongside its {{pkmn|Trainer}}. Since ''[[SM061|A Mission of Ultra Urgency!]]'', she has been stationed at the [[Ultra Guardians]]' base below the [[Pokémon School]], having been selected by Lusamine to assist Ash and {{ashcl}} during their Ultra Guardians' missions. She usually greets them when they first arrive before pointing to the monitor where Lusamine, [[Wicke]], and Professor Burnet will make contact. In ''[[SM111|Show Me the Metal!]]'', Clefable was cleaning the Ultra Guardians' base when she came across a group of {{OBP|Meltan|recurring}} that began eating anything made of metal. Clefable trampled the Meltan, causing them to flee up to the Pokémon School, but they later returned. In the [[SM112|following episode]], Clefable learned of their taste for metal and went on to train them to follow her around. Later, she had the Meltan perform a few tricks for Kukui and his class. ===Personality and characteristics=== Clefable has a friendly and playful personality, as seen during {{an|Lillie}}'s flashbacks. She has a close bond with Lillie, which allowed her to break free from {{DL|Ultra Beasts (anime)|Nihilego}}'s control. Her friendship with Lillie made her the perfect choice of Pokémon to be stationed at the [[Ultra Guardians]]' base. Clefable is a thoughtful and helpful Pokémon, as shown in the [[Poké Problem]] extra scene for [[SM089]], where she gave {{an|Professor Burnet}} a cup of {{DL|Pokémon Center Café|Drinks|Komala Coffee}} after all of the hard work she had done on studying {{an|Necrozma}}.
